tasting_notes: Latvia's national herbal bitter to a 1752 apothecary recipe; 24 botanicals incl. ginger, oak bark and linden in a dark, intensely bittersweet balsam.
Blackcurrant-infused lighter version of the balsam; sweeter berry over the herbal base.
Cherry-infused version of the balsam; ripe cherry softening the bitter botanicals.
Coffee-led expression joining the global coffee trend; roasted espresso over the balsam base.
Higher-botanical-intensity expression of the balsam with added bilberry and other botanicals.
